name: keel-desktop
description: Keel — Agentic Product Development Platform (desktop app)

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../dashboard/frontend install && npm --prefix ../dashboard/frontend run build && node scripts/copy-frontend.mjs
scripts.dev: cross-env KEEL_DEV=1 npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.package: npm run build:electron && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run smoke:backend && electron-builder
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:electron && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run smoke:backend && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:win: npm run build:electron && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run smoke:backend && electron-builder --win
